records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Partners
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Created first project on day 1 (2026-08-18) but no activity since; no invite sent, no key milestone, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:9eb43f7e]. Silence for ~5 days on a Starter single-user account suggests low unaided momentum, though 8 days remain and the first project shows some intent.

draft.subject: Quick next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's a solid start.

The next step that usually makes the biggest difference is getting someone else in with you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what you're trying to organize and suggest the best next move.

Best,
Priya
